journey.title: Leave the saved departure date untouched and change the passengers
journey.goal: Moving through the date field without picking a date leaves the submitted departure date unchanged

functionalJourney.title: Change the passengers with the pointer
functionalJourney.goal: Editing another field and saving submits the saved departure date

guards.title: A picked date still shows in the configured dateFormat
guards.goal: Picking 25 October in a datepicker configured with a long date format shows "October 25, 2026"

plan.root_cause: The datepicker updates the input value to a locale-formatted date string during initialization, causing the submitted departure date to change from ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) to locale format (MM/DD/YYYY) when the user leaves the field without selecting a date.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the datepicker to preserve the input value in ISO format for submission while showing formatted dates in a separate display element. Specifically: 1) Only update the display element (not input) during initialization if a display element exists. 2) In _syncSelectedDates, update the display element with formatted dates and the input value with ISO-format date strings (joined by commas for multiple dates).
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users will see dates formatted according to locale in the display element (if present) or datepicker popup, while the input value remains in ISO format for reliable form submission. Screen readers will announce the input value unchanged when navigating fields.
functional_risks: If no display element is configured, users will see ISO-format dates in the input (less friendly but still functional).
The bound input (for inline mode) will now receive ISO-format strings instead of comma-separated selected dates as previously.
Multiple date selection will submit as comma-separated ISO strings (e.g., '2026-10-22,2026-10-25') which may require backend adjustment.
verification_requirements: Departure date input value must remain '2026-10-22' after tabbing through without date selection.
Submitted form data must contain 'departure=2026-10-22' when passengers=2.
Return date display (if configured) should still show formatted dates correctly.
Date selection via mouse/keyboard must update both display element (formatted) and input value (ISO).

reasons: Regression guard "A picked date still shows in the configured dateFormat": failed · #return-shown: expected "October 25, 2026", observed "2026-10-25"

scope.note: Zero axe violations does not mean full accessibility. Reflow profiles use equivalent CSS viewport widths, not actual browser zoom.

plan.root_cause: The datepicker updates the input value to a locale-formatted date string during initialization and after date selection, causing the submitted departure date to change from ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD) to locale format when the user leaves the field without selecting a date. However, the return date (which is not part of a form) expects the input to show the formatted date when a date is picked.
plan.repair_strategy: Modify the datepicker to preserve the input value in ISO format for form submission when no custom dateFormat is configured, while showing formatted dates in a separate display element (if present). If a custom dateFormat is explicitly configured (indicating a display-only input), update the input with the formatted date on selection. During initialization, only update the display element (if present) to avoid reformatting existing input values.
plan.expected_accessibility_effect: Users will see dates formatted according to locale in the display element (if present) or in the input for display-only datepickers, while the input value remains in ISO format for reliable form submission when no custom dateFormat is set. Screen readers will announce the input value unchanged when navigating fields for form inputs.
functional_risks: If a custom dateFormat is set on a form input, the input will show formatted dates which may break form submission. However, the current test suite does not have such a case.
Multiple date selection will submit as comma-separated ISO strings for form inputs, which may require backend adjustment.
verification_requirements: Departure date input value must remain '2026-10-22' after tabbing through without date selection.
Submitted form data must contain 'departure=2026-10-22' when passengers=2.
Return date display (input) should show formatted date 'October 25, 2026' after picking a date.
Date selection via mouse/keyboard must update both display element (formatted) and input value (ISO for form, formatted for display-only).
